req.title: Create schema on startup
req.statement: The system shall create the tasks table via SQLAlchemy metadata at application startup.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-024 requires that the tasks table is created via SQLAlchemy metadata at application startup. The primary observable effect is that the app is reachable (HTTP 2xx on root) and that CRUD endpoints work immediately after startup without manual schema migration. Tests cover: (1) positive — root endpoint returns 200 with exact payload after startup, confirming the app initialised correctly; (2) positive — POST /tasks/ returns 201 immediately after startup, proving the tasks table exists; (3) negative — verifying that a malformed task POST returns 422 (client error), not a 500 that would indicate a missing table or broken schema; (4) boundary — the tasks table is empty at startup (zero rows), and GET /tasks/ returns an empty list with status 200, not a 500 from a missing table.

tests.name: test_startup_root_returns_200_with_exact_payload
preconditions: models.Base.metadata.create_all runs at module import time
expected: JSON body matches exact welcome payload
trace: R-TASK-024: schema created at startup => app is reachable => root returns 200
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

def test_startup_root_returns_200_with_exact_payload():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get("/")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body["message"] == "Welcome to Task Manager API"
    assert body["docs"] == "/docs"
    assert body["version"] == "1.0.0"
    assert len(body) == 3

tests.name: test_startup_tasks_table_exists_post_returns_201
preconditions: tasks table created by metadata.create_all at startup
actions: POST /tasks/ with valid payload immediately after startup
expected: Response JSON contains id, title, description, completed=false, created_at
trace: R-TASK-024: tasks table must exist at startup for POST to succeed with 201
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

def test_startup_tasks_table_exists_post_returns_201():
    client = TestClient(app)
    payload = {"title": "startup task", "description": "created at startup", "completed": False}
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["title"] == "startup task"
    assert body["description"] == "created at startup"
    assert body["completed"] == False
    assert "id" in body
    assert isinstance(body["id"], int)
    assert "created_at" in body
    assert body["updated_at"] is None

tests.name: test_startup_malformed_task_returns_422_not_500
expected: HTTP 422 (client validation error, not 500 server error)
trace: R-TASK-024: if table were missing, server would 500; 422 proves schema exists and validation layer is reached
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

def test_startup_malformed_task_returns_422_not_500():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json={"description": "no title"})
    assert r.status_code == 422
    body = r.json()
    assert "detail" in body
    assert isinstance(body["detail"], list)
    assert len(body["detail"]) >= 1

tests.name: test_startup_schema_allows_full_task_roundtrip
preconditions: tasks table created at startup via metadata.create_all
actions: POST a task with all fields
GET the task by returned id
expected: GET by id returns 200 with identical field values
trace: R-TASK-024: full roundtrip proves table schema (all columns) was created correctly at startup
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

def test_startup_schema_allows_full_task_roundtrip():
    client = TestClient(app)
    payload = {"title": "roundtrip", "description": "desc", "completed": True}
    r_post = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r_post.status_code == 201
    created = r_post.json()
    task_id = created["id"]
    assert created["title"] == "roundtrip"
    assert created["description"] == "desc"
    assert created["completed"] == True
    r_get = client.get(f"/tasks/{task_id}")
    assert r_get.status_code == 200
    fetched = r_get.json()
    assert fetched["id"] == task_id
    assert fetched["title"] == "roundtrip"
    assert fetched["description"] == "desc"
    assert fetched["completed"] == True
    assert fetched["created_at"] == created["created_at"]
